name: Unitec Institute of Technology
description: Unitec is a polytechnic, not a university, in Mount Albert, Auckland, that awards its own bachelor's and master's degrees. It was part of Te Pūkenga, the national polytechnic network, from 2020, and since 1 January 2026 it has been run together with Manukau Institute of Technology as one stand-alone polytechnic.
whyIncluded: Unitec Institute of Technology is among the 10 institutions in New Zealand most chosen by international students (1,700 international students enrolled in 2025, Ministry of Education provider data; New Zealand has only eight universities, so the two largest degree-granting polytechnics were added), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.
